info.name: MindfulToken(APP)
info.description:
# Mindful Ocean API's called by mobile and web applications

Except for "Apple ID Login" & "signin" API calls, need to pass the following parameters for authentication/security checks:

appleId - apple ID returned after apple sign in  
currentTime - current time in Unix time format  
secret - md5(appleId+currentTime)  
refreshToken - refresh token returned after apple sign in
